I changed `ndarray_to_mgr` in `pandas/core/internals/construction.py` so the workload no longer copies the data twice. I haven't run the repository's test suite, so the change is untested beyond a quick check.

With `copy=True` and a dtype that differs from the input, it used to copy the array first and then copy it again in the dtype conversion. The first copy is now skipped when the conversion will make a copy anyway. This applies only to plain numeric NumPy arrays (integer, unsigned, float and bool) with a non-extension target dtype.

The workload now takes about 1.0 ms per call. I didn't time the original code, so I can't give a before/after figure. I also haven't run the full 1000-iteration script.

I checked that the result is still independent of the input. After changing the source array, the DataFrame still shows 0 in its first cell and keeps dtype `int32`.
